name: zerochart-prospective-signal-outcomes
referencePrice: OPEN of the first UTC daily candle whose open time is strictly after observedAt
endpointPrice: OPEN of the UTC daily candle exactly horizon calendar days after reference open time
benchmark: BTC-USD over the identical reference and endpoint timestamps

missingDataRules.pending: endpoint open time is later than collection time
missingDataRules.available: one validated candle exists at each exact required timestamp
missingDataRules.missing: endpoint has occurred but a required exact candle is absent
missingDataRules.invalidConflicting: duplicate, invalid, or conflicting provider data

interpretation: Reference-price signal research only; not fills, a portfolio backtest, risk-adjusted alpha, or evidence of executable profitability.
